title: Planned nbn network upgrade – Airlie Beach, QLD
current_summary:
Affects nbn services in Airlie Beach, QLD. Work is scheduled from 12:00 am to 6:00 am AEST on Tuesday 24 November 2026, and services are expected to be offline for the full six hours.

nbn is upgrading a local fibre connection point in your area so it can support more connections. Your internet service will be offline while the work is carried out.

This planned outage is to upgrade the Multi-Port Terminal (MPT) to increase the amount of fibre connections at the port. As this upgrade work is being performed at the network level, customers may not experience a noticeable increase in performance for their individual service.

nbn® is completing upgrades on the nbn network in your area. This will cause your nbn service to lose connection.
Using mobile data where available can help you stay connected while your service is offline. Minimise disruption to your routine by downloading required files and switching to offline work modes.

cause.reason: Planned network upgrade to increase the number of fibre connections at a local connection point.
